summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 2, 2026. The meeting included approval of annual accounts, director liability release, appointment of a non-executive director and external auditor, amendment of articles to increase authorized capital, and authorizations to issue and repurchase shares. All items passed with widespread support. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign.
